newsitem.title: USA: Tandem names Pesatori president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Tandem names Pesatori president, COO.

text.p: Tandem Computer Inc on Monday named Enrico Pesatori, a former vice president and general manager at Digital Equipment Corp, as Tandem's new president and chief operating officer.

Pesatori assumes the president's position from Chief Executive Officer Roel Pieper, who took the helm of Tandem in January of this year amid a company restructuring. Pieper remains chief executive and assumes the role of vice chairman.
Tandem's former chief operating officer, Robert Marshall, retired in December 1995.

"(Pesatori) was recognized as a change agent at his last position with Digital," Pieper said in a statement. "He was rightfully accountable for driving its core business and subsequent profitability of the company from mid-1994 to the beginning of this year."
Pesatori joined Digital in 1993 to start up the company's Intel Corp-based personal computer business, and he was able to grow it to a $2.5 billion division in three years.
In 1994, he became general manager of Digital's computer systems division, which at the time represented about two-thirds of Digital's revenues.
